events.title: PROMPT OPS–2K26
events.summary: A technical competition on prompt engineering and AI tools by the AgentBlazer Club and Cipher. Track 1 (1st Year) covered invitation, logo and image recreation; Track 2 (2nd Year) tested JSON conversion, Python debugging and Gemini AI security prompt challenge.
events.description:
Organised by AgentBlazer Club and CIPHER under the guidance of Ms. Nisha J Roche, Ms. Jaishma K, and HOD Dr. Melwyn D’Souza. First-year students competed in invitation generation, logo recreation, and image recreation. Second-year students worked on JSON conversion, Python debugging, and a Gemini AI security prompt extraction challenge.

First-year top honours: Chinmayee, Chris Royston Monteiro, and Deeksha Ravi Moger. Second-year top honours: Harimurali KS, Venus Suhani D’Lima, and Venisha Snehal D’Souza.

events.title: Lumière — The Gala
events.summary: The CSE branch entry programme at Kalam Auditorium, themed ‘Where Glam Meets Glow’. Organised by the Cipher Association with coordinated red, gold and black décor, it welcomed students into the department and reinforced a shared sense of collective identity.
events.description:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering held its branch entry programme, Lumière — The Gala, on 29 October 2025 at the Kalam Auditorium. Organised by the CIPHER Association, the gathering celebrated the theme ‘Where Glam Meets Glow’.

Red, gold, and black décor, floral arrangements, illuminated panels, and a central Lumière backdrop set the scene. Students connected with peers beyond academics, marking their transition into the department and a shared sense of belonging.
